answers.q1_prior_analyst_review_concept: Concept documented in RCA-2A.15 audit; backend logic lived in agent_findings.py (FindingReviewService) and agent_runtime.py (commit_finding_review), but lacked an application service facade and HTTP routes.
answers.q2_reusable_review_services: FindingReviewService and AgentRuntimeRepository.commit_finding_review provide canonical human-only review mutation primitives.
answers.q3_accepted_finding_data_model: InvestigationFindingV1 and SQLite table investigation_findings (columns: finding_id, proposal_id, disposition_id, text, assertion_class, evidence_refs_json, status, reviewed_at, reviewer, review_note, review_id).
answers.q4_hypothesis_stable_identity: _server_assigned_id('h', {'text': action.text}) producing IDs such as h-448201.
answers.q5_working_state_storage: hypotheses (tuple of Hypothesis with supporting_refs), finding_refs, and pending_proposal_refs in AgentWorkingStateV1.
answers.q7_review_decision_states: accepted and rejected explicitly enforced by SQLite trigger trg_investigation_finding_legal_transition.
answers.q8_review_history_and_immutability: investigation_finding_reviews is strictly append-only, enforced by triggers trg_investigation_finding_review_no_update and trg_investigation_finding_review_no_delete.
answers.q9_report_evidence_linkage: report_evidence table links (task_id, evidence_key, analysis_id); finding acceptance does not auto-admit report evidence.
answers.q10_workbench_review_status: InvestigationReadService and investigation_workbench.py read finding and claim statuses from investigation.db.
answers.q11_unconnected_responsibilities: HTTP routes for querying candidates and submitting analyst reviews, plus ServiceManager property wiring.
answers.q12_reviewer_identity_handling: Caller-supplied reviewer string recorded on finding and review history rows; documented as REVIEWER_AUTHENTICATION_LIMITATION without mock auth.
